summary: This note is a short biographical entry on E. Denise Simmons, a former mayor of Cambridge, Massachusetts, whose first mayoral term fell in the 2008–2009 term. It identifies her as the first openly lesbian African-American mayor in the United States, and names her predecessor Kenneth Reeves as the first openly gay African-American mayor in the country. It also explains that the mayor chairs the city's legislative body, while the non-elected city manager serves as chief executive officer.
